ask: How did my posts do last month?

steps.why: What went out, with numbers. Posts under a day old have not synced: leave them out of rankings.
Account-level numbers. Never mix them up with one post's results.

say: Acme, Oct 1 to Oct 31: 14 posts went out, 12 on LinkedIn and 2 on X. Your two best on LinkedIn were both customer stories. Want next week's drafts to lean that way?
never: Comparing networks with fewer than 5 posts.
